# InfoSecurity Global Q4 2024 Earnings Report

## Executive Summary

InfoSecurity Global delivered exceptional financial performance in 2024, demonstrating the strength of our manufacturing-focused cybersecurity solutions. The company reported record revenue of $4.34 million, representing a robust 44.0% year-over-year growth from $3.01 million in the previous year. Net income reached $442,657, yielding a healthy operating margin of 10.2%, which reflects our disciplined approach to scaling operations while maintaining profitability. With our workforce of 831 employees, revenue per employee increased to approximately $5,217, indicating improved operational efficiency and productivity gains across our organization.

## Revenue and Profitability Analysis

The remarkable 44.0% revenue growth significantly outpaced industry averages and underscores the increasing demand for specialized cybersecurity solutions within the manufacturing sector. This growth was driven by strong adoption of our integrated security platforms across all three core product lines. Our operating margin of 10.2% demonstrates effective cost management and operational leverage, particularly impressive given our substantial investment in research and development and sales team expansion. The company's ability to generate $442,657 in net income while simultaneously funding growth initiatives positions us well for continued market expansion and reflects the scalability of our business model.

## Business Segment Performance

Our three core product segments each contributed meaningfully to overall performance, with Quality Control security solutions leading growth due to increased regulatory compliance requirements in manufacturing. Supply Chain security products experienced accelerated adoption as manufacturers prioritized supply chain resilience and visibility following recent global disruptions. Production Planning security modules saw steady growth as industrial IoT implementations expanded across our customer base. The manufacturing sector's digital transformation initiatives continue to drive demand for our specialized solutions, with customers increasingly recognizing the critical importance of securing operational technology environments alongside traditional IT infrastructure.

## Forward-Looking Guidance

Looking ahead to 2025, InfoSecurity Global expects continued strong performance driven by expanding market opportunities and our proven ability to execute. We anticipate revenue growth of 25-35% as we capitalize on our strengthened market position and launch enhanced AI-powered threat detection capabilities across our product suite. The company plans to strategically increase our workforce by approximately 15% to support customer growth and accelerate product development initiatives. With a robust pipeline of enterprise customers and growing recognition of manufacturing cybersecurity as a critical business imperative, we remain confident in our ability to deliver sustained profitable growth while maintaining our industry-leading operating margins.
